subject: Business Models
title: Product-Led Growth
description: A fast breakdown of Product-Led Growth for builders.

hook.text: Slack, Zoom, and Notion grew without salespeople. Users signed up, invited colleagues, and companies paid later.

buildup.text: Product-led growth (PLG) means the product itself drives acquisition, conversion, and expansion.

discovery.text: In PLG, free users are the sales team. Every shared document or meeting invite is a product demo.

twist.text: PLG breaks when enterprise buyers need security reviews and contracts. Eventually, you still need salespeople.

climax.text: Most successful PLG companies add sales teams at scale. Product opens the door; sales closes the deal.

punchline.text: Users sell to users. Product-led growth makes every user a salesperson.

quiz.question: What is the core idea behind product-led growth?
options: The product itself drives user acquisition and conversion

details.summary: Product-led growth is a business strategy where the product itself drives customer acquisition, conversion, and expansion rather than traditional sales and marketing teams. Users discover the product for free, experience value independently, and upgrade to paid tiers when they need more.
details.whyItMatters: PLG has produced some of the fastest-growing software companies in history including Slack, Zoom, and Notion. It reduces customer acquisition costs by letting users self-serve.
takeaways: The product is the primary vehicle for acquiring and converting customers
Users self-serve through onboarding without needing sales interactions
PLG companies often achieve faster growth at lower customer acquisition costs

faq.question: How does product-led growth differ from traditional sales-led growth?
faq.answer: Sales-led growth relies on sales representatives to demonstrate, negotiate, and close deals. Product-led growth lets users try the product freely, experience value, and convert to paid without human interaction. PLG reduces sales costs but requires excellent product design and onboarding.

faq.question: What metrics define successful product-led growth?
faq.answer: Free-to-paid conversion rate measures product monetization efficiency. Time-to-value measures how quickly users reach the aha moment. Product-qualified leads identify users showing buying signals through behavior..
